Zoe (Marketing): quick ask for launch collateral: we need a reproducible 10k stratified rerun that stresses tail latency + multilingual edgecases. Buckets: <32, 32-256, 256-1024, >1024. Langs: en, es, zh, ar, other. Run variants: rwd-7b-v1 (fp32) and rwd-7b-q4_0_v2. Deliverables: per-slice p50/p90/p99, token-cost, failure rate, prompt-length CDF, and raw traces. Use seed=54321. Can we have CSVs + traces by Tue morning?

Jordan (Runtime): can do. couple clarifying q's: 1) do you want warm vs cold separated? 2) routing mix: prod proportions or force equal per-lang? 3) concurrency sweep?

Zoe (Marketing): separate warm/cold please. define warm = warmup_tokens=3 and tag warm requests with header X-Bench-Warm=1. Use production routing mix but enforce min 1k samples per language. Yes to concurrency sweep 4/8/16. Cap sequences >8192 to avoid very long jobs.

Amy (Eng): note: >1024 takes a different kernel path and will skew p99 & token-cost. recommend logging kernel_path and kernel_fallback_count. if zh failures concentrate, we should try a short follow-up with zh warmup=8.

Sam (Ops): scheduling low-priority run on staging at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. example run I'll execute:

./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-v1 --quant=fp32 --samples=10000 --seed=54321 \
  --buckets "<32,32-256,256-1024,>1024" --langs "en,es,zh,ar,other" \
  --min_per_lang 1000 --warmup_tokens 3 --warm_header "X-Bench-Warm=1" \
  --concurrency 8 --batch 32 --cap 8192 --tag marketing-tailproof
./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-q4_0_v2 --quant=q4_0 --same-flags

benchbot: Job queued -> jb-20260310-310. ETA ~5h. logs: https://ci/internal/jb-20260310-310/logs

benchbot: jb-20260310-310 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/marketing/5222223333/. quick first-pass: q4_0_v2 reduces p50 on <32 by ~9% but shows p99 regression ~14% on >1024. overall failure rate 0.26%, concentrated on long zh samples. kernel_fallback_count: 22 (mostly zh tokenization). per-slice CSVs and raw traces uploaded.

Zoe (Marketing): great, thanks all. We'll review CSVs/plots and flag any follow-ups (likely zh warmup experiment). This should be enough for the initial launch slides and webinar script. :rocket:
